sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines the required ship-to-other-survival-craft or device-assignment/inventory relationship; the only candidate is the Ship class and cannot establish per-craft device obligations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate omits the required every-other-survival-craft scope and instead checks two aggregate counts directly on the ship, so one ship-level count can pass without establishing that each applicable craft carries both devices.
